body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2NidJm7Tzd128tJp4sbpQtK)_

## What
Removes the vterm setup, a suspect for the Emacs start-up hang (follows #259).

- `sp-terminal`: vterm, `vterm-always-compile-module t`, `siapip/start-vterm` and `<f7>` / `C-M-S-x` are gone. `eat` (pure Lisp, no native module) stays.
- `sp-workspaces`: the Terminal workspace (`sp-vterm-workspace`, `sp-open-new-terminal-and-workspace`, leader key `6`) used `multi-vterm` and is gone.
- `sp-ai`: `claude-code` now waits for `inheritenv` and `eat` only, with `claude-code-terminal-backend` set to `eat`.
- `sp-frame`, `sp-evil`: vterm leftovers removed.
- Docs: org sources edited first, `.el` files to match. README and beets docs now say to run the deploy script with `M-x compile`.

## Not run
No Emacs in the container, so the tangle check and start-up were not run.

comment_regular_data.body:
The `tangle` check is red only for `libraries/modules/base/navi/sp-search.el` (1 insertion, 3 deletions of drift), a file this PR does not touch. Every module this PR edits (`sp-terminal`, `sp-workspaces`, `sp-frame`, `sp-evil`, `sp-ai`) tangles to what is committed. The `sp-search` drift is the one #252 and #253 were about, so I'm leaving it for those and not widening this PR.
